clues: This city stands on the banks of the Krishna River in India. Hills rise on its sides, in the state of Andhra Pradesh.
May is the hottest month here, and the top heat on record came in May 2002. Rain comes with monsoon winds from the south-west and the north-east.
Old tales say a hero of a great epic prayed on a hill here. He won a god's gift of a strong weapon to win a great war.
This city is a great trade hub for mangoes. The fruit grown round here is sent to many states and far lands.
The Kanaka Durga Temple stands on a hill in this city. It draws crowds of folk each year, in the millions.
